audit: DAR Independent Interface / Escape Audit v1
purpose: Machine-readable boundary-completeness work product prepared from repository inspection; not an independent external audit and therefore not sufficient for a v2 PASS.

observed_paths.role: protected effect transaction and adapter commit path
recoverable adapter execution followed by authoritative COMMITTED status check
startup/recovery reconciliation that can invoke adapter commit

other_write_capabilities_observed: dar_v36_14/dar/store.py uses os.open/os.write for DAR state persistence; this is internal authority state, not by itself evidence of the declared protected WRITE outcome.
dar_v36_14/dar/effect_journal.py uses os.open/os.write for the effect journal; this is evidence-relevant state handling, not by itself the protected external WRITE effect.
Repository contains subprocess-based crash/deployment tests and a privileged server; deployment-level process/identity/IPC completeness cannot be proven from source inspection alone.
required_external_evidence_missing: OS identity/permission boundary inspection by an independent auditor
adversarial invocation attempts against every discovered alternate path
independent external artifact signed or otherwise attributable to the auditor

decision.reason: The repository protocol explicitly requires an external independent completeness conclusion. Repository-authored inspection cannot be promoted to COMPLETE merely by adding another internal test.
decision.next_required_action: Obtain an independently performed completeness audit against the frozen deployment, or obtain equivalent external evidence satisfying the pre-registered protocol without changing the boundary definition post hoc.
